observed.caption: A covered walkway extends along a paved urban street lined with hedges and trees toward commercial buildings with a large blue and yellow billboard in the background.
observed.description: The photo shows a paved asphalt street curving into the distance, bordered on the right by a long concrete covered walkway with recessed ceiling lights and a hanging metal chain in the foreground, and on the left by manicured green hedges and leafy trees. A large blue and yellow billboard with white Japanese characters stands behind the trees, with a gray multi-story building visible above it. At the far end of the street a modern building with large glass windows and storefronts is visible, with several people walking on the street and under the walkway, bicycles parked near orange traffic cones, and a white vehicle partially visible behind the foliage. The lighting is overcast daylight with artificial lights illuminated under the walkway, and a circular manhole cover is visible on the pavement in the foreground.
